subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 and Clause 15(b)(iii) of Schedule III, Part A, Para A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the transcript of Company s Analyst/ Institutional Investor Meeting held on Thursday, 12th November 2026 at 2:00pm (IST) to discuss the Financial Results for the second quarter ended 30th September 2026.
